regions.summary: Mechanics, shared fields and control continuations explained in InstallBoardFeatureIntro, BoardFeatureStatusFrame, ChooseFeatureStatusText, WriteFeatureStatusText, AdvanceFeatureStatus, MaybeAdvanceFeatureObject, RenderFeatureStatusFrame, BoardFeatureIntroFrame, RenderFeatureIntroObject, CheckFeatureIntroMilestones, MaybeStepFeatureIntro, FinishFeatureIntroFrame.

units.name: InstallBoardFeatureIntro
units.summary: Store the category sprite color and install BoardFeatureIntroFrame through the callback helper.

units.name: BoardFeatureStatusFrame
units.summary: Refresh status text on alternating frames. Every 32 frames write zero to another player/category indicator and queue paired effects; keep the board and auxiliary object moving until SceneCountdown expires.

units.name: ChooseFeatureStatusText
units.summary: Choose the stage/player message; one stage/difficulty combination emits an extra text fragment.

units.name: WriteFeatureStatusText
units.summary: Append two selected text fragments, then the current player counter and shared status tiles.

units.name: AdvanceFeatureStatus
units.summary: Pause the scene countdown while the current player is moving. Four category indicators advance independently of the per-frame board rendering.

units.name: MaybeAdvanceFeatureObject
units.summary: The preceding call or frame mask leaves A here; values at least 14 with bit zero set trigger another auxiliary update.

units.name: RenderFeatureStatusFrame
units.summary: Update player sprites, auxiliary slot 4 and board strips, then dispatch the next frame or finish the countdown.

units.name: BoardFeatureIntroFrame
units.summary: Animate the auxiliary object during the timed feature introduction. ScenePhase selects fade, sound and target-square changes before the shared frame tail.

units.name: RenderFeatureIntroObject
units.summary: Before phase $A0 draw players in depth order; all phases continue drawing the auxiliary object and applying the board split.

units.name: CheckFeatureIntroMilestones
units.summary: The A=$68 milestone transfers to feature setup. At phase $B1 clear auxiliary movement and queue an effect; later alternate frames may advance it again.

units.name: MaybeStepFeatureIntro
units.summary: Only even phases with BoardSceneEffectFlag set advance the auxiliary feature state.

units.name: FinishFeatureIntroFrame
units.summary: Join the ordinary sound/frame dispatcher.

units.name: CompareEnteredAnswerLetter

units.name: HandleAnswerLetterComparison
units.summary: A zero comparison selects success. Otherwise place the letter sprite offscreen and initialize its height/movement before resuming answer scanning.

units.name: QueueCorrectLetterEffect

regions.summary: Mechanics, shared fields and control continuations explained in WriteFourBlankAnswerTiles, ClearCompletionNametableBands, AnswerCompletionFrame, UploadCompletionOam, AdvanceCompletionDrawing, RaiseCompletionPaletteEntry, ChooseCompletionTransition, FinishCompletionDrawingFrame, RestartAfterCompletionDelay, EvaluateCompletionAnswer, CheckCompletionFrameMilestones, CompareCompletionAnswerLoop, SelectIncorrectAnswerFeedback, WriteCompletionFeedback, CheckCompletionReplayTime, FindNextAnsweringPlayer, DelayAfterAllPlayersAnswered, CheckPlayerAlreadyAnswered, ResumeAnswerEntryForNextPlayer, UploadCompletionPalette, RestoreCompletionPpuMode, SetCompletionOamLimit, FinishCompletionOam, StartCompletionResultSound, DrawLateCompletionMarker.

units.name: WriteFourBlankAnswerTiles
units.summary: Write four $0B tiles at the current PPU cursor; callers establish address and increment mode.

units.name: ClearCompletionNametableBands
units.summary: Clear three 32-byte bands beginning at PPU $2300 and fill the last 16 attribute bytes at $23F0 with $55.

units.name: AnswerCompletionFrame
units.summary: Completion callback installed by the fixed-bank hook. ComputerAnswerFlag bit 0 selects the active drawing/fade path; the other path evaluates the answer, displays feedback and chooses replay or transition.

units.name: UploadCompletionOam
units.summary: Upload shadow OAM when this countdown is not the nametable-clear milestone.

units.name: AdvanceCompletionDrawing
units.summary: Restore PPU mode, update the drawing and answer state, then periodically raise selected palette entries toward category colors.

units.name: RaiseCompletionPaletteEntry
units.summary: Clamp nonblack entries upward to the selected category color; traverse palette entries 27..24 and 3..1.

units.name: ChooseCompletionTransition
units.summary: A short remaining countdown initializes scene transition state and object updates; longer countdowns retain completion rendering.

units.name: FinishCompletionDrawingFrame
units.summary: Use the shared completion renderer.

units.name: RestartAfterCompletionDelay
units.summary: Return to the common setup/restart entry after the delay expires.

units.name: EvaluateCompletionAnswer
units.summary: Upload OAM and service any post-answer delay. At frame $24 compare nonblank stored answer letters minus one with entered letters, then choose the feedback text.

units.name: CheckCompletionFrameMilestones
units.summary: Frame $24 tests answer correctness; later $FE starts the feedback/remaining-player sequence.

units.name: CompareCompletionAnswerLoop
units.summary: Ignore zero answer bytes; all others must equal the entered glyph after subtracting one.

units.name: SelectIncorrectAnswerFeedback
units.summary: Select the alternate feedback text and increment the completion result state.

units.name: WriteCompletionFeedback
units.summary: Write the selected PPU text record, then restore normal completion display state.

units.name: CheckCompletionReplayTime
units.summary: Before frame $FE continue palette upload. At $FE initialize the next feedback phase; afterward search for a present player who has not answered.

units.name: FindNextAnsweringPlayer
units.summary: Scan four player slots, skipping present players already marked answered. Exhaustion displays the no-player text and starts a $C0-frame delay.

units.name: DelayAfterAllPlayersAnswered
units.summary: Show the final message, initialize the delay and clear the answer display.

units.name: CheckPlayerAlreadyAnswered
units.summary: Skip an answered player; otherwise restore the answer-entry callback and its timing state.

units.name: ResumeAnswerEntryForNextPlayer
units.summary: Prepare the next answer attempt, install its callback, extend the puzzle timer and reinitialize answer/display state.

units.name: UploadCompletionPalette
units.summary: Upload the current faded palette before common display setup.

units.name: RestoreCompletionPpuMode
units.summary: Restore control mode and scroll state before drawing completion sprites.

units.name: SetCompletionOamLimit
units.summary: Select cursor $24 before hiding the unused completion sprites.

units.name: FinishCompletionOam
units.summary: Hide unused OAM from cursor $24 up to $60. Frame $25 initializes the category state and result-dependent sound once; late countdowns also draw the answer marker.

units.name: StartCompletionResultSound
units.summary: Start the selected sound and latch bit 1 in the completion state so this result is recorded.

units.name: DrawLateCompletionMarker
units.summary: Draw the answer marker only for countdowns at least $21, then enter the common frame tail.

Three-byte stream headers lead to high-bit note selectors, durations and positive command/operand bytes; repeated motifs and substream pointers occupy this whole payload area. Individual stream extents and a universal token grammar remain unresolved. The MMC1 register address alias that happens to fall inside this physical storage is not an audio label.

units.summary: Sign-extend A through SoundPointerHi and add it to the low/high timer pair.

regions.summary: Mechanics, shared fields and control continuations explained in DrawAuxiliaryEffectSegment, UseFlatAuxiliarySegment, AddAuxiliarySegmentBaseY, AdvanceAuxiliaryEffectSegment.

units.name: DrawAuxiliaryEffectSegment
units.summary: For the last segment add a triangular vertical offset from phase Y; otherwise use the base Y. Clip nonzero high-coordinate results, emit one OAM record and advance the phase and seven-pixel base spacing.

units.name: UseFlatAuxiliarySegment
units.summary: All but the selected last segment have no triangular displacement.

units.name: AddAuxiliarySegmentBaseY
units.summary: Add the segment displacement and feature counter to the base Y; a nonzero high result clips this OAM segment.

units.name: AdvanceAuxiliaryEffectSegment
units.summary: Advance the phase by two modulo 64, move the segment base by seven pixels and repeat for the remaining segments.

regions.summary: Mechanics, shared fields and control continuations explained in BuildPauseScreenSprites, BuildPauseTileRow, BuildPauseTileCell, AdvancePauseTileRow, WaitForPauseControllerPress.

units.name: BuildPauseScreenSprites
units.summary: Load the pause palette and build five rows of eight OAM tiles. Hide sprite zero while waiting for a fresh controller press, then restore audio, rendering state and the saved sprite-zero Y.

units.name: BuildPauseTileRow
units.summary: Emit eight OAM records across the row. After the upper four rows, move to the lower row and change its attribute bit.

units.name: BuildPauseTileCell
units.summary: Write position, table tile and attributes at OAM cursor X; each cell advances X by four and screen X by eight.

units.name: AdvancePauseTileRow
units.summary: Keep the next row Y, stop after forty tiles and wait in the input loop.

units.name: WaitForPauseControllerPress
units.summary: Wait for vblank, upload OAM, enable rendering and poll fresh button edges. A press restores state and returns to the frame dispatcher.

regions.summary: Mechanics, shared fields and control continuations explained in UpdateDrawingTileNeighborhood, IndexDrawingTileRow, ResolveDrawingTileOperation, ReadDrawingNeighborTiles, TransformFirstDrawingNeighbor, MaybeTransformRemainingNeighbors, RestoreDrawingPpuIncrement, TransformDrawingNeighborTile, EmitDrawingTileMotionSprite, CheckSecondDrawingHistoryCell, CheckThirdDrawingHistoryCell, RememberDrawingMotionCell, WriteDrawingMotionOam, RestoreDrawingTransformIndex, WriteDrawingReplacementTile, AdvanceDrawingTransformIndex, AdvanceDrawingTransformCoordinate, AdvanceDrawingTransformY.

units.name: UpdateDrawingTileNeighborhood
units.summary: Direction class selects PPU increment, coordinate masks, table row and tile transforms. Read three neighboring tiles, preserve compatible joins and rewrite the affected cells; restore vertical increment mode on return.

units.name: IndexDrawingTileRow
units.summary: Transform the masked Y coordinate, optionally double it, then combine the X contribution to select the tile-operation record.

units.name: ResolveDrawingTileOperation
units.summary: The operation byte supplies a transform index plus flags: bit 6 backs up the PPU cursor, bit 5 permits additional neighbor writes.

units.name: ReadDrawingNeighborTiles
units.summary: Read the three buffered PPU neighbor tiles, restore the cursor and choose between preserving a special join or transforming the first tile.

units.name: TransformFirstDrawingNeighbor
units.summary: Transform the first tile unless the middle tile already matches the special current-tile join.

units.name: MaybeTransformRemainingNeighbors
units.summary: Operation bit 5 enables the second tile; command classes 6/11 also inspect delay and current-tile equality before choosing the third.

units.name: RestoreDrawingPpuIncrement
units.summary: Restore PPU control $82 and return to drawing.

units.name: TransformDrawingNeighborTile
units.summary: Choose the replacement from the transform table. Blank, placeholder and already-correct tiles skip sprite emission; a changed real tile may become a temporary sprite before replacement.

units.name: EmitDrawingTileMotionSprite
units.summary: Align the caller coordinates to a tile cell. Suppress duplicates using a three-cell circular history; otherwise emit an OAM tile and advance the bounded drawing sprite cursor.

units.name: CheckSecondDrawingHistoryCell
units.summary: Compare the candidate with history slot one before checking the third.

units.name: CheckThirdDrawingHistoryCell
units.summary: Compare the candidate with history slot two; a match suppresses duplicate sprite emission.

units.name: RememberDrawingMotionCell
units.summary: Write the new X/Y pair into the three-slot ring and wrap its cursor at three.

units.name: WriteDrawingMotionOam
units.summary: Emit the original tile with attributes $22. Cursor $FC is saturated rather than wrapping beyond OAM.

units.name: RestoreDrawingTransformIndex
units.summary: Restore the caller X and load the replacement tile for the shared PPU write.

units.name: WriteDrawingReplacementTile
units.summary: Write replacement A to PPUDATA, then advance the transform index and drawing coordinate by eight.

units.name: AdvanceDrawingTransformIndex
units.summary: Advance table index X and choose the ordinary eight-pixel drawing step.

units.name: AdvanceDrawingTransformCoordinate
units.summary: Incoming A is a signed pixel step. Command low bits select Scratch08 (X) or Scratch09 (Y).

units.name: AdvanceDrawingTransformY
units.summary: Advance the Y scratch coordinate by the selected signed step.

units.name: DecodePackedAnswerBlock
units.summary: Read a signed repetition count and optional bit-position mode. Append flagged coordinate and answer records; each packed letter has a five-bit value plus spacing in its upper three bits. Mark the final record and append a zero terminator.

units.name: BeginPackedAnswerRecord
units.summary: Set previous-record flag bit 1, append the next two coordinates and advance packed input after each.

units.name: DecodePackedAnswerGlyph
units.summary: Keep the spacing bits from one byte and the five-bit glyph from the next, storing glyph|$40 in the output.

units.name: ExpandPackedAnswerSpaces
units.summary: Subtract spacing units of $20; intermediate units append literal space tiles before the next glyph.

units.name: FinishPackedAnswerRecord
units.summary: Mark previous output with bit 7 and repeat while the signed count is nonnegative; finally append zero.

regions.summary: 184 packed puzzle records selected through the CHR-resident high-first pointer catalog. PRG pointers are offsets from CPU $E0FD. The decoder expands coordinate commands, relative direction steps and packed answer fields into RAM. Independent static decoding consumes exactly the next catalog start for all 184 records, ending at physical $7F62 before the fixed hook. This copy path reads 120 bytes into PackedPuzzleBuffer; consumed record lengths vary. CHR storage also contains catalog/puzzle bytes, so CHR is not exclusively artwork.
